modelDescription: Where value and performance meet, is where the Stevens Model 334 bolt action rifle excels. The rifle features a 2 staged adjustable trigger and a 60-degree bolt lift to allow faster loading on follow-up shots. The barrel is free-floating and button rifled for consistent accuracy. Offered in three popular calibers, the Stevens Model 334 is available in a Turkish Walnut stock option with a silver bolt or a black synthetic stock with a matte black action to match.
